name: Deviation Edge (COMPAS CEM)
description: Create a deviation edge from a line.

inputParameters.name: line
inputParameters.description: A line that defines the end nodes of the edge.

inputParameters.name: state
inputParameters.description: The force state of the edge: positive for tension, negative for compression. Only its sign is used, and it must be nonzero.

inputParameters.name: force
inputParameters.description: The magnitude of the force on the edge. Only its absolute value is used.
